newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments up on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments up on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1 and November 26 were 3.9 percent above their year-ago level, mostly the result of higher flour and barley sales, member country officials said on Friday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain exports ahead on last year at 12.256 million tonnes against 11.800 million.
Flour export commitments reached 2.848 million tonnes, up from 2.735 million during the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports jumped to 2.685 million tonnes from 1.137 million during the same period last year, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Commercial wheat exports, however, were still lagging on last year at 3.625 million tonnes against 3.947 million.
Malt exports fell to 1.762 million tonnes from 2.153 million.
Since November 26, the EU has granted 198,900 tonnes of soft wheat, 99,385 tonnes of barley, 35,692 tonnes of rye and 20,500 tonnes of oats exports through its weekly grain tender system.
